name: George "sophron" Chatzisofroniou
biography: George Chatzisofroniou is a computer security researcher and engineer specializing in Wi-Fi and wireless network security. He has conducted infrastructure and software security testing for Fortune 500 companies across Africa, Asia, Europe, and North America. His research has been presented at leading security conferences and has attracted media coverage for uncovering critical protocol-level vulnerabilities.
